nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Firmness and Elasticity

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum keeps skin hydrated and non-flaky through harsh winters, though one dry-skin reviewer says it burned and left skin dry afterward.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, calmed redness, and improved eczema-prone or reactive skin (including rosacea), while others describe hives, swelling, burning, or acne-like bumps.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report smoother texture and less visible pores, with one describing it as sensitive-combination and seeing reduced pore appearance.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-60s report smoother texture, plumping, and reduced fine lines and dynamic wrinkles, including on the forehead and around the eyes.
segments.oily: One reviewer reports the serum reduced oily/dry imbalance and gave a healthy glow, though another notes it temporarily enlarges pores right after application.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers in their 30s to 60s report smoother texture, plumping, and visibly reduced fine lines and dynamic wrinkles (forehead, under-eye, smile lines); one reviewer felt it was too weak to show noticeable anti-aging results beyond hydration.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration and a plumping effect, including in dry and cold climates; a few report the opposite, with skin feeling dry, tight, or increasingly dehydrated over time.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers say the serum calmed redness and irritation marks, but others report the product caused facial redness, swelling, or a red bumpy rash.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the product with protecting and strengthening the skin barrier; another reports it compromised her barrier, leaving skin rough, cracked at the mouth corners, and inflamed.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts with continued use; many others report new breakouts, cystic-like bumps, or whiteheads appearing within days of starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report tiny bumps, hives, or white-headed pimples appearing shortly after application, sometimes resolving quickly after stopping; a smaller group reports no such reaction and continued clear skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the serum balanced oily and dry patches into a more even, glowing complexion; another notes temporary pore enlargement right after use that subsides within about 30 minutes.

extraits.titre: Didn't Appreciate Until I Ran Out
extraits.texte: I think this product is great for skin texture, brightness, and dryness. I teally didnt appreciate how much it was helping my skin until I ran out and suddenly my skin just looked like garbage (dull, bad texture). I have very reactive, sensitive skin with Rosacea and am prone to severe Rosacea texture issues (hard patches of skin, rough texture, flakiness). When I use this I have almost none of those issues.

I have been using this product for almost a year… and the results are amazing. its very hydrating, and helped my acne so much. if your worried about sensitive skin, i have it and had no reaction to it. the only thing i find wrong with it is that it makes my pours slightly larger right after use, but calms down about 30 minutes or so after. i also have acne prone skin, so this really worked.

I figured it was time to review after 2 years of using this aka "buffet". My skin is sensitive and combination so maybe it works differently for others but this saved my skin. I live in an area where winter season is dry and very cold but with this my skin is NEVER dry or flaky. I used to always get eczema around my eyes and after using this I haven't had a breakout since. Even when I got breakouts on my arm I'd put this on to help. It dries nicely for me as well.

Chemical burn from using this one time. Look at the pic. Bright red and purple. My face has been like this all day. It is extremely hot and is making me feel sick. This is only in the areas that I used this product.

I've been using it for years now. It's helped even out skin texture and hydration. During the pandemic, I started to focus on setting up a proper skincare routine. My sister recommended this. For the first couple of years, I used it morning and night after washing face and followed up by a moisturizer. Now I use it in the morning (retinol at night now). Any time I've run out and thought I'd be fine without it, my skin starts acting up; so I start using this again and my skin clears up quickly. For reference, I'm 38 years old with dry skin.

extraits.titre: Great addition to m skincare routine!
extraits.texte: I have dry sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin at all and had no reaction when patch tested. I only been using it long enuff to use half a bottle but already see improvements in my skin (I will update after longer use). My skin isn't as red and my irritation marks have drastically improved. Skin skin looks and feels softer and smoother like it's already starting to improve my texture. That alone makes it worth it and can't wait to see what other improvement lay ahead with further use. I use this every morning and every night except on the nights that I use my lactic acid serum which is about 2-3 times a week. I gently smooth it over my face and neck then gently press it in to my skin then let it sit a cpl minutes before applying my moisturizer. The price is higher than I expected for this brand but for this product and the fact that's its already improving my skin I say it's worth it. I just gave some to my mom to try yesterday so if she has no irritation then will get her a bottle and see how it works for both of us together. I highly recommend atleast trying this product if ur in ur 20s or older. Everyone can benefit from a product like this!

Extremely uncomfortable on the skin. it doesn't feel like your skin is actually absorbing anything, its just a thick and sticky layer that sits on top. Even if you layer with another serum or moisturizer, you still feel sticky for hours. The thickness made my skin feel as though it could not "breathe" so it also made my face sweat. Used as directed for a full month and had no changes to my skin.
